bpe.text: The tower stands in the city. The tower is tall and the city is old. In the city of towers, every tower is located near the river. People in the city say the tower is the heart of the city, and the river is the soul of the city. Tourists come to the city to see the tower and the river, and they stay in the city for the night.
bpe.newText: The Eiffel Tower is located in the city of Paris, near the river Seine. Every year people come to see the tower.
